page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 32 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4 GB of memory per core. Storage is bundled as a single 402 GB local NVMe SSD, while no dedicated GPUs are present.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench text processing scoring in the top 25%. Most general compute metrics, including multi-core CPU performance, software compilation, and static web serving throughput, fall within the average range. However, a notable hardware tradeoff exists in memory subsystem performance; while cached small-block read bandwidth is average, large-block uncached read and write memory bandwidths are weak and poor, falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a dense resource profile by combining dedicated AMD EPYC compute cores with fast local NVMe storage. This makes it suitable for workloads that require a balance of processing power and low-latency local storage without the overhead of network-attached disks. Appropriate workloads include database operations, web serving, text processing, and general-purpose application hosting.
